failure.duplicate_listing: Already listed — this ASIN is in your active or draft listings.
failure.ebay_duplicate_item: You already have an identical listing live on eBay for this product. End that eBay listing, or import it instead of creating a new one.
failure.zero_stock: Out of stock on Amazon after your stock buffer, so the quantity would be 0.
failure.quota_exhausted: Plan limit reached. Upgrade or free up listing slots to continue.
failure.asin_not_found: ASIN not found — no matching product exists for this identifier.
failure.product_data_unavailable: Amazon product data could not be retrieved for this ASIN.
failure.category_unresolved: eBay could not match this product to a listing category.
failure.category_aspects_unavailable: eBay item-specific data was temporarily unavailable.
failure.aspect_missing: eBay requires the item specific {{aspects}} and no value could be derived.
failure.aspect_rejected: eBay rejected the value we sent for {{aspects}}.
failure.ebay_policy_missing: Your eBay business policy is missing or not valid for this marketplace.
failure.ebay_auth: Your eBay account connection needs to be renewed.
failure.ebay_rate_limited: eBay rate-limited the request. Retrying later usually works.
failure.ebay_unavailable: eBay was unavailable while publishing. Retrying usually works.
failure.ebay_restricted_item: eBay restricts this item or category for your account.
failure.provider_budget_exhausted: Today's eBay API allowance is used up. This listing is queued and will continue automatically.
failure.blacklisted_keyword: Your Store Settings blacklist blocked this listing (keyword: "{{keyword}}"). Remove the keyword or adjust your listing template.
failure.cancelled: Cancelled before this ASIN was processed.
failure.unknown: The listing could not be created.
